limitations: This census compares fixed evaluated c92 candidate run 37491677036 with candidate generation 37519882295 (8dd3e24aeb81ec4eec29edcf9b3b18987bdbc912); the browser comparison uses a separate frozen 7b application/catalog baseline.
This aggregation does not inspect image pixels or approve supplemental original-image reviews. Native automated QA success and manual image review remain separate.
The historical independent 360-photo holdout remains failed; full additions review does not relabel that sample as an independent final PASS.
These are actual selected-profile/pose counts under unchanged strict/observed/background tier rules, not a claim of general visual quality or publication.

methodology.countReconciliation: All computed profile counts, occupied profile cells, evidence-tier counts and raw direction counts match each candidate generation physical receipt.
methodology.directionInterpretation: Signed raw-pose groups retained exactly as the physical validator. No mirrored UI direction or new visual yaw assessment is inferred.
methodology.poseCells: Use unchanged stored poseCell values; do not flip signs or reassign cells. Full 31 yaw × 25 pitch grid, 3-degree centers.
methodology.rows: All 70,000 exact inventory rows in each candidate; no sampling or fresh inference. SHA bindings, canonical bytes, uniqueness, profile/tier membership and raw record delta verified.
methodology.zeroProfiles: All declared profiles appear in each cell, including zero counts. Null minimum means no such gate is declared; it is not a newly introduced zero threshold.
